text_block_list.text:
I was training with Rice Shower,
but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I've been having scary dreams lately... surrounded by dark shadows,
saying words Rice can't really understand—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Because it keeps happening...
I've even become scared of going to sleep... *sigh*."

Rice Shower seems to be in pain.
If only there were something I could do for her...
